source_logic.monster_melee_stop: Original monster_OnTargetInMeleeRange calls Stop before DoSkill/Attack. Stop routes through the current controller and source stop event; it is not a general inter-actor spacing rule.
source_logic.movement: Native controller Cmd_MoveTo asks its current path owner for a route to the target object; Cmd_Stop invokes the current stop owner and Character event0x3f. RuntimeEnemyNavigationV1 uses the same actor PFObject, sewn floor route, static _colbox_ checks, boundary heading and retained locomotion. It has no actor-to-actor avoidance policy or extra radius.
source_logic.contact: Source Character bodies have real NPC collision callbacks that resolve the same peer owner and raise source AI collision events. AISExternal constructor has mutable collision counters at +0xbc/+0xc0; the exact collision owner is documented in port/level-world/reference/character-world-npc-collision-v1/integration.md. `character_body_config.cpp` gives Mage/player category 0x4, mask 0xd7f, group -1 and Lizard type4 category 0x10, mask 0xd3f, group 2; the reciprocal masks admit contact and groups do not suppress it. Main binds each callback through its body registry and `RuntimeSessionContactOwnerV1`; `NativeWorld::ShouldCollide`/`deliver_contact` run real filters and event callbacks. See reports/actor-physical-source.json.
source_logic.current_runtime_boundary: The historical unbound capture did not execute NativeWorld Step. The latest 227F capture executes 360 Steps in the actual Session/NativeWorld frame and imports the accepted same-actor position back into Session; it logs no contact callback count.

investigation_before_test.expected_behavior: Preserve source MoveTo/Stop and authored melee handoff; on a real same-Session NativeWorld Step, physical actors may contact and the source callback is routed to the registered source actor owners. The native Box2D position solver allows up to 1.5*b2_linearSlop of residual penetration; test against that recovered tolerance, not an invented spacing offset.

investigation_before_test.focused_test_plan: Run the source-bound 360-frame close-approach capture with the same Session and real NativeWorld Step; correlate final ActorState XY with retained same-actor NativeBody XY/radii; require each pair's penetration to be no greater than 1.5*b2_linearSlop (0.75 game units), derived from the source Box2D solver; preserve the historical unbound log as a red regression.
